Class DistributionFrequencyDeriver

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.instrument.lookup.DistributionFrequencyDeriver
public final class DistributionFrequencyDeriver extends Object
Derives the distribution frequency of an instrument from the ex-dates its dividend connector delivers, the same way a user counts the distributions on DivvyDiary or Yahoo.

The distributions of the last 3 full calendar years are counted per year. When the first distribution in the fetched history falls into one of these years, the instrument probably started distributing then, so only the years from that one on count, and that first, usually incomplete year is dropped as long as a later full year remains. The median of the yearly counts - robust against a single special dividend or an ex-date moving across the turn of the year - is mapped to the nearest regular frequency when it deviates by less than 25%, otherwise to DistributionFrequency.DF_AD_HOC.

No distribution at all in the whole period means DistributionFrequency.DF_NONE, e.g. an accumulating fund, unless the listing is younger than a year. Less than one full year of distributions leaves the frequency open, as does a single counted year in which the listing itself started.

    • combine

      public static DistributionFrequency combine(DistributionFrequency providerFrequency, Collection<LocalDate> exDates, LocalDate listedSince, Boolean distributing, LocalDate today)
      Determines the frequency proposed for one dividend connector. A frequency the provider states itself, such as DivvyDiary's dividendFrequency, takes precedence over the derivation from the ex-dates. "No distribution" is never proposed for a fund that the master data marks as distributing, nor for a listing younger than a year: a newly listed distributing fund simply has no dividends yet, so the frequency stays open.
      Parameters:
      providerFrequency - frequency stated by the provider, null when none
      exDates - ex-dates delivered from historyStart(LocalDate) on
      listedSince - first trading day of the listing, null when unknown
      distributing - true for a distributing fund, false for an accumulating one, null when unknown
      today - the reference day
      Returns:
      the frequency, or null when it stays open

    • derive

      public static DistributionFrequency derive(Collection<LocalDate> exDates, LocalDate listedSince, LocalDate today)
      Derives the frequency.
      Parameters:
      exDates - ex-dates delivered from historyStart(LocalDate) on; may contain older dates
      listedSince - first trading day of the listing, null when unknown
      today - the reference day
      Returns:
      the frequency, or null when the history is too short to tell
